item.title: Trump Pushes ‘Super Intelligence’ Rebrand, Musk Follows
item.description: President Trump orders AI be renamed ‘Super Intelligence,’ prompting Elon Musk to rebrand SpaceX’s AI project as SpaceXSI, sparking industry debate.
